value.rationale: A natural elementary noncomplete graph is globally nonregular, but the theorem shows its typical element has the opposite behaviour (regular and noninjective), with a sharp m^-1/2 law, complete rank census and idempotent count. This quantifies an intrinsic semigroup statistic of a natural growing graph family and contrasts global with density notions of regularity. It is not a fixed-size numerical experiment.
